name: Garment Mantra Lifestyle Limited
about: Garment Mantra Lifestyle Limited manufactures, distributes, and sells fabrics and hosiery garments in India. The company offers pyjama sets, shorts, long polo, frocks, T-shirts, capri sets, and lycra plants; and accessories, such as watches, belts, shades, handbags, bracelets, and wallets. It sells products for men, women, kids, and family, as well as deals in white labels. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Junction Fabrics and Apparels Limited and changed its name to Garment Mantra Lifestyle Limited in April 2020. Garment Mantra Lifestyle Limited was founded in 1997 and is based in Tirupur, India.
